summary: reAlpha Tech Corp. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of InstaMortgage Inc. via merger of its subsidiary, Merger Sub, into InstaMortgage, with InstaMortgage surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Aggregate consideration was $8.5 million: $500,000 cash plus $1,500,000 in reAlpha common stock at closing, with remaining amounts subject to closing adjustments. The parties waived two outstanding regulatory approvals to close. The original merger agreement was dated December 19, 2025, amended on August 17, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for post-closing adjustments, stock issuance details, and integration of mortgage operations.
